Looking along the time axis, the dashed-line climate humidity index has periodic fluctuations, but in modern times it has not formed a synchronized strengthening with the solid-line sedimentation rate with the same amplitude and same rhythm; while the solid-line sedimentation rate in the later period, especially in modern times, has clearly increased fluctuations, showing relatively intense rises and falls.
